card.name: Words before a container or room
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, into, over, or, the, 's) just before a container or enclosed space is named, such as a bowl, bottle, syringe, oven or child's room. It is strongest in preparation and instruction steps.

modes.label: Into a container
modes.description: A preposition or article right before a vessel such as a bottle, bowl, pot or syringe in preparation steps.
modes.example: Pour the microcapsules completely into<< the>> larger bottle of diluent.

modes.description: The 's after a child, leading to room.
